details: Bitcoin (BTC) is trading around $83,003.71, up slightly by 0.04% in the last 24 hours. However, it is struggling to maintain this level, remaining approximately 34% below its October 6, 2025, peak of $126,080. This comes one year after a significant $19 billion crypto liquidation event. Institutional demand for Bitcoin has weakened, with US spot Bitcoin exchange-traded funds (ETFs) experiencing over $700 million in outflows this week.
title: Bitcoin Struggles Above $83,000 Amid ETF Outflows

details: Ethereum (ETH) has dropped below the $2,500 mark, trading near $2,499.77, with only a narrow 0.39% increase in 24 hours. The decline is influenced by rising oil prices, higher US Treasury yields, and broad selling pressure across crypto markets. US spot Ethereum ETFs have recorded nine consecutive days of net outflows, totaling roughly $697 million by October 9, with BlackRock's iShares Ethereum Trust (ETHA) seeing significant redemptions. Ethereum exchange reserves have also increased, indicating potential selling pressure from holders.
title: Ethereum Dips Below $2,500 as ETF Outflows Persist

details: The total value locked (TVL) across Ethereum Layer 2 (L2) networks has declined to $33.47 billion, marking a 1.37% drop over the past week. Base leads the L2 ecosystem with a TVL of $15.73 billion (down 2.46% over seven days), followed by Arbitrum One at $11 billion (down 2.84%). OP Mainnet, however, saw a slight increase of 0.3%.
title: Ethereum Layer 2 TVL Decreases by 1.37% Weekly

details: Solana (SOL) recently implemented a network upgrade on October 9, 2026, allowing it to create a new block every 200 milliseconds, significantly faster than Bitcoin's average of 10 minutes. Despite this technical improvement, Solana's price dropped by 7.9% over the past week, trading around $110. This suggests that market momentum and broader sentiment currently outweigh technical enhancements in driving SOL's price.
title: Solana Speed Upgrade Fails to Boost Price as SOL Drops 7.9%

details: COTI announced its COTI 2.0 initiative on October 10, introducing "Interphase" for confidential asset transfers across over 30 blockchains and "COTI Global" for private everyday crypto payments. Separately, Japanese exchange OKJ revealed plans to list Midnight's NIGHT token on October 13, making it the first Japanese crypto exchange to offer NIGHT through order-book trading.
title: COTI Unveils New Privacy Products; Japan's OKJ to List Midnight's NIGHT Token

details: On October 10, MEXC issued a notice detailing the removal of 14 USDT-margined perpetual futures markets, including contracts for BOBA, RON, ZBCN, and TFUEL, effective October 14. Additionally, KuCoin temporarily suspended Monero (XMR) deposits and withdrawals for wallet maintenance, with no specific timeline provided for restoration.
title: MEXC to Delist Futures Markets; KuCoin Pauses Monero Withdrawals

details: Ripple's (XRP) price fell by 1.01% to $1.39 on October 11, underperforming a slightly positive broader market. This drop is largely attributed to a sell-off in leveraged derivatives positions as speculators exit bets ahead of Evernorth's (XRPN) Nasdaq listing on October 12. Trading volume for XRP plunged over 53% in 24 hours, and futures open interest declined, signaling a de-risking trend among traders.
title: XRP Price Drops Ahead of Evernorth Nasdaq Listing

details: Verasity (VRA) has seen a significant price increase, climbing over 10% in the last hour and 18.96% in the last 24 hours. This surge is reportedly fueled by growing institutional interest in crypto markets and the anticipation of potential ETF approvals. The heightened trading volume suggests that investors are increasingly focusing on assets with potential for upside.
title: Verasity (VRA) Climbs Over 10% Amid Institutional Interest

details: The Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC) on October 10 proposed new rules that would formally define event contracts, including those related to sports and politics, as "swaps" under federal law, while distinguishing them from traditional gambling. In separate news, a life insurance company backed by Sam Altman, which operates entirely on Bitcoin, reportedly raised $37.5 million.
title: CFTC Proposes Defining Prediction Markets as Swaps; Bitcoin-Backed Life Insurer Raises $37.5M
